updates.title: Lab scheduling link issue
updates.body:
-Lab scheduling link issues

When issues occur for lab scheduling please do the following:

Verify lab scheduling is not working on our end and not just the patients

If it is not working, then this indicates the issue is not specific to the patient, and tech should be notified.

Please send message to Tech_CS channel.

Send message to the patient letting them know our tech has been notified.

Snooze ticket to follow up on the matter next day.

If Tech has not provided any updates attempt to utilize the link.

If it works please notify the patient to proceed.

If it does not work continue to snooze until tech provides an update or we see resolution on our end.

-Patient states they did not agree to auto renewing subscription

The following macros have been updated for if a patient messages in stating they did not agree to an auto renewing subscription. These include an image of the terms each patient agrees to when they sign up for the associated HRT/TRT subscription. Here are the macro titles:

Patient states they did not sign up for auto renewing subscription at a rate of $199 every 4 weeks

Patient states they did not sign up for auto renewing subscription at a rate of $499 every 12 weeks

Patient states they did not sign up for auto renewing subscription at a rate of $1799 every 48 weeks

Please let me know if you have any questions!

updates.author: Good morning
updates.title: Progesterone sublingual 300 mg no longer offered
updates.body:
Good morning @channel. We have some Updates and Reminders for the day. Please review.

UPDATES

-Sublingual Progesterone 300mg

We will no longer be offering progesterone sublingual 300 mg for new patients or for follow-ups and the patients will be receiving a blast message letting them know about the change.

If a patient has any additional questions from the message they receive, please defer to the SS team

-HRT Labs not required for specific patients

We have successfully been seeing New York HRT patients with no labs for several weeks now. We are going to broaden the pilot program to several other patients in different states.

Please ALWAYS first check to see if a lab order was generated.

If no lab order was generated, that means they are part of our no labs pilot program. Please do not offer labs to these patients.

updates.author: Unknown
updates.title: Requests routed to shift supervisor
updates.body:
-Charge cost of labs if outside of a subscription

In the following two scenarios we will manually charge the patient a $35 fee for lab work. (Additional charges would apply if the patient chose to schedule at LabCorp or have any expanded panels tested.)

If a patient meets with a provider and it is determined that they need to have labs redone to reevaluate if they are a candidate for HRT/TRT (prior to them setting up a subscription), we will need to charge the $35 fee for the additional lab draw prior to scheduling.

When a patient cancels their subscription and wants to complete a follow up visit with the provider to determine if they want to continue treatment. If the provider then recommends labs before the patient decides they'd like to continue with a subscription, they will need to be charged the $35 lab fee prior to scheduling.

CS will send these scenarios to the Shift Supervisor team for review/approval.

Once confirmed that the patient qualifies for the lab work outside of a subscription, it will be sent back to CS to process charge and provide the scheduling link to the patient.

REMINDERS

-Relay Macro/Rerouting questions and concerns

When a patient messages in and their request/question needs to be routed to a different department we want to make sure we acknowledge the patient and let them know that we’ve received their message, and are seeking assistance from another department.

CS please take the following steps:

Notify the patient that you are relaying their concern over to the correct department

Please utilize the macros listed under General CS: Relay for these situations

Then reroute the conversation or create a ticket for the correct department.

updates.title: Existing patient price change process
updates.body:
-Existing Patients Requesting new prices

If an existing patient signed up under our previous prices at a higher rate and is requesting to be switched to our current lower rate we can honor this request.

These matters can be sent to SS to review/address.

We just do not want to offer this to the patient; it is only if they request it specifically.

updates.title: Pharmacy process update
updates.body:
-Failed Payments caught up

If we see a case where a payment fails for one month and the patient makes a payment to their next subscription charge date when it arrives, they still end up with a failed payment tied to the new charge.

Typically the system does not prompt any services while their subscription is inactive from failed payments. Due to this, the new charge should be voided or the charge date should be delayed.

Please send these cases to the SS for review/action to void payment or delay the charge date.

Remember to also create the refills and clarifications ticket for the pharmacy team to monitor any refills that may have been missed due to nonpayment

updates.title: Pharmacy process update
updates.body:
-Curexa Delays when asking for overnight shipping

If a patient requests expedited shipping for a medication that is filled through Curexa specifically (Tcream, Tadalafil, Anastrozole doses over 2.5mg) it is not necessarily beneficial since we have to cancel the order and request the change in shipping which can cause more of a delay.

Please send the patient the following macro: General CS: Curexa Overnight Shipping Request

Please let me know if you have any questions!
